domain: open axis: a filing-arrival uncertainty-premium SCHEDULING book on the death-inclusive cohort - a time-conditional holding overlay built on the funded filing-event clock (V11-E1) and the published pooled cadence (V11-E3), with the sector-residual book-form provision (plan 2.1) exercised in the neighbour arm under a mechanism justification frozen here. The exposure is a holding indicator over PIT-predicted arrival windows: no direction, no return/volume/price input, no fundamentals value, no revision direction/severity, no timing-lag observable is ranked anywhere. This proposal converges blind on the V10 eligible-but-never-scored A4-H2 idea space (filing-event reaction) as the plan authorizes, but is a NON-DIRECTIONAL scheduling family, not a drift/direction family - the within-cycle separation is declared in novelty_declaration.
title: Disclosure-event uncertainty premium: hold names through their PIT-predicted annual-report arrival windows (next evidenced arrival + 364 days, +/- 7 calendar days), long scheduling overlay with a mandatory sham-calendar control, sector-residual neighbour per the 2.1 provision

mechanism.who_is_the_constrained_or_mispriced_acto: The marginal holder of small-cap equity at disclosure events. Two constraint channels make holders shed or refuse event-window exposure: (1) tracking-error and risk-budget constraints - a diversified mandate that holds a name through its annual-report window is buying a lumpy idiosyncratic jump that no benchmark-relative budget compensates, so the rational institutional posture is to be flat or underweight INTO and THROUGH the disclosure (Frazzini-Lamont's 'investors shy away' object; Savor-Wilson's scheduled-announcement premium for the macro analog); (2) attention and information-processing costs - the arrival event is precisely when disagreement about the name must be resolved and when attention-constrained traders (Barber-Odean) are least able to process the release, so the household side de-risks ahead of low-salience scheduled events (Hirshleifer-Teoh). The issuer side cannot smooth this: the arrival date is a scheduled uncertainty release the holders, not the firm, must finance.
mechanism.why_the_mispricing_persists: The premium is a RISK PRICE, not a mispricing that converges: it is paid only to whoever actually holds through the window, so 'arbitraging' it means re-taking the same idiosyncratic event risk - concentration cannot remove it, only re-price it. Diversified institutions cannot harvest it at all (tracking-error budgets); dedicated event funds capacity is finite and concentrated in large caps; and the cohort's dead tail (1,726 of the 2,131 covered priced entities here are DEAD_EVIDENCED) lies outside every index, ETF and event-fund mandate - nobody is positioned to compete for that window risk at all. The scheduling information itself (annual cadence around 364 days) is free, which is exactly why the premium survives: the constraint is not knowing WHEN, it is being WILLING AND ABLE to hold.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: A holding indicator over PIT-predicted arrival windows. Predictor (frozen): next_hat_i(t) = latest evidenced first_avail stamp of entity i strictly before the scheduling decision + 364 calendar days - the 364 anchor is the published pooled cadence p50 from the V11-E3-AMEND-CADENCE clock tuple (cadence_p10_p50_p90_days 169/364/460), a census number, not a fitted one. Window: [next_hat - 7, next_hat + 7] calendar days (a symmetric +/-7-day disclosure window; one constant pair, no grid). At each weekly scheduling decision the book opens a tranche holding every eligible entity whose predicted window starts within the next 5 sessions, entering at the next trading bar after the window start and exiting at the first trading bar after the window end. Predictor quality is part of the mechanism's falsifiable content: if the +364 schedule cannot place actual arrivals inside the windows, the windows are generic calendar time and the sham control shows exactly that.
mechanism.why_not_a_vetoed_form_in_new_words: The exposure is a TIME-CONDITIONAL HOLDING INDICATOR - scheduling geometry, not a cross-sectional characteristic. It is not momentum/semivariance/vol-level (no return, variance or volume anywhere); not any balance-sheet form (WC-stock, Goodwill, accrual-flow, depletion, cash-level - no filed VALUE is read); not sector-exposure form (sector enters only the neighbour's hedge legs and the benchmark reporting contract, never the signal); not V10's deseasonalized-timing characteristic book (that veto ranks a filer filing-lag z-score LEVEL cross-sectionally; here no lag observable is ranked or conditioned - evidenced arrival DATES are used only as calendar placement, which is what the funded V11-E1 clock IS); not revision-correction direction/breadth (no corrected value exists in the design). No cycle has preregistered a scheduling/announcement-premium book; the plan names event-form reaction and the 2.1 book form as the untouched frontier this family occupies.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (a) if there is no uncertainty premium at these horizons, anchor windows earn their beta only and the SPY-excess gate fails; (b) if the +364 predictor cannot localize arrivals (schedule misses), anchor windows are statistically indistinguishable from sham windows and the control ratio gate kills the family - the V5 sham-calendar lesson imported as the mandatory crucible; (c) if window-length beta drift (sector/market) carries the raw book, the anchor's SPY-excess fails while the sector-residual neighbour isolates whether anything idiosyncratic remains; (d) if the premium is smaller than band costs on a 10-11 bar hold, expectancy is nonpositive and the 2x stress rerun is decisively negative; (e) if window truncation at the dead tail (exit beyond series end) is structurally large, the scored-window count abstains under the floors - INFEASIBLE, declared.

falsifiable_prediction: The scheduling book's window expectancy (per tranche, after base band costs, 3 folds) is positive, exceeds the sham-calendar control's window expectancy with |sham expectancy| < 0.5 x |anchor expectancy| (same sign; the sham never outruns a negative anchor), has position PF >= 1.10, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, max fold MDD <= 15%, and positive SPY-excess expectancy overall and in >= 2 folds. The neighbour (sector-residual, 2.1) is expected to retain the anchor's premium if the mechanism is idiosyncratic uncertainty pricing; a neighbour that loses the anchor's edge while the raw anchor appears profitable is declared evidence of sector-timing, not mechanism, and downweights the family. The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the sham control matches or outruns the anchor including the negative-anchor case (frozen falsification-by-control rule, mandatory sham-event placebo class); pooled novelty |rho| > 0.20 vs any of the ELEVEN veto entries at D2 on conditioning exposures; drop-one survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; reproduction is not ALL_MATCH. REJECT is a successful outcome.

universe.legs: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) - the death-inclusive cohort frozen in p3_v11_invariants_freeze.json (carried payload). GAP_COVERAGE (513) and NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) excluded-with-reasons, recorded, never held.
universe.eligibility: at each scheduling decision, an entity's predicted window is schedulable iff: (i) >= 63 bars of history through the scheduling session in the entity's own series; (ii) band C or better at the entry decision (ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD; UNTRADABLE excluded at decision); (iii) RAW close >= 1.00 USD at the entry decision; (iv) a predictor state exists: at least one evidenced first_avail stamp strictly before the scheduling decision within the 800-day staleness bound; (v) the window start falls strictly inside the current fold.
universe.dead_name_semantics: preregistered: a window whose exit bar falls beyond the entity's series end is exited at the last recorded close on the final session (the delisting return is carried by the price series itself; windows truncated this way are counted and reported as a structural dead-tail statistic, never silently dropped and never re-substituted); fill-check enforced (a missing bar at entry means the window does not open - no synthetic continuation); no post-series prices read, interpolated or synthesized; no survivorship re-substitution. The 4,270 zero-post-bar filer-events of the P0 census are event-anchored truncations; this family is schedule-anchored, and its own truncation statistic is measured and reported by A9 before selection.
universe.no_lookahead_in_class_labels: alive/dead attribution is computed only as post-hoc stratified REPORTING; the predictor and eligibility never use survival class. The predictor uses only stamps strictly before the scheduling decision (P-1): no future arrival date, actual or asserted, enters any window placement - the entire family is a bet that the PAST cadence predicts the NEXT arrival.

sanctioned_clocks_cited.observable: arrival event (cik, first_avail) with post-arrival bookable window W bars
inter_arrival_days / amend_count (cadence of the amendment process)

clock.citation_usage: V11-E1 supplies the event stream and its bookable-window evidence (74,931 filer-events; 94.08% with >=5 strict post-arrival bars) and V11-E3 supplies the published pooled cadence percentile whose p50 = 364 days is the frozen predictor anchor. No new clock is invented; the predictor is arithmetic over the V11-E1 stream using the V11-E3 published statistic.
clock.staleness: p2 clock_semantics.staleness_rule_declared_ex_ante, verbatim: 'every conditioning input uses max_age_days 800 (the V9/V10 funded-clock bound, carried unchanged); no unbounded variant'. A predictor state older than 800 days abstains fail-closed (the entity's cadence is no longer evidenced).
clock.no_contemporaneous_inputs: a first_avail stamp enters the predictor state iff it is strictly earlier than the start-of-day UTC of the scheduling decision; date-only stamps take the conservative-later bound (first session strictly after the stamp). No actual future arrival ever conditions anything.
clock.window_convention_declaration: the P2 clock_semantics STRICT_NEXT_BAR/SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE conventions govern event-anchored books; this family's windows are SCHEDULE-anchored (predicted dates), so the convention is declared here explicitly: entry bar = first entity trading bar strictly after the window start; exit bar = first entity trading bar strictly after the window end; both under fill-check; the sham control recomputes under any semantics change (P-3).
clock.lag_mutation_declaration_P3: mandatory event-book lag mutation honored in schedule form: pushing an evidenced filing stamp later - while still before the scheduling decision - shifts the predictor state and next_hat one-for-one, so the traded window shifts by exactly the same amount and nothing else changes; a stamp pushed past the scheduling decision leaves the predictor state unchanged (it was not yet available); every window's membership moves and no other parameter moves.
clock.deadline_distance: NOT cited: DATA_BLOCKED_VALID per p2_v11_coverage_first.json not_funded (P-1); the predictor is arrival-history-based, never deadline-based.

warmup_rationale: one scheduling step: the predictor needs no expanding history beyond the entity's latest evidenced stamp, and the only warmup-consuming rule is the 63-bar eligibility floor at entry, which the first fold's first scheduling step satisfies fail-closed (windows whose entity lacks history do not open). No additional abstention declared; no window is placed before S0_FOLD_1 starts.
decision_grid: weekly 5-session scheduling grid strictly inside each fold: at scheduling decision t, every eligible entity whose predicted window starts within the next 5 sessions is scheduled into a new tranche (equal weight across that tranche's windows; tranches are independent; opened windows run to their own exit and are never rebalanced). Folds frozen per p3_v11_invariants_freeze.json carried payload: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24. All positions force-flat at every fold boundary with cost. Scored decisions = scheduled windows (lane pre-check: 37,527 predicted windows land inside the folds under the frozen predictor - 14,846 / 12,262 / 10,419 by fold - a count made from the P0 derived artifact and price availability only). Max six scored cells cycle-wide (V11 budget 0/6); unused slots never reassigned.
entry_exit_fills: band-resolved house fills: entry order generated at the scheduling decision for the first trading bar strictly after the window start, filled close-to-close at the next session, no same-session fill; fill-check: a name without a bar at the entry session does not open its window (the order does not exist; tranche weights of OPENED windows are NOT renormalized - realized gross is reported); exit order at the first trading bar strictly after the window end, same fill rules; force-flat with cost at fold boundaries; L-I3 fail-closed band resolution throughout (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py); truncated dead-tail exits at last recorded close per universe.dead_name_semantics, charged per resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling when the exit band is unrateable).

costs.model: p3_v11_invariants_freeze.json carried payload, verbatim: 'band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side base, stress x2 applied to booked PnL; costs linear in fills; charged exactly once per fill'. Kernel: BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of(ADV63): >= 50,000,000 A, >= 10,000,000 B, >= 2,000,000 C, else UNTRADABLE; entries never use the UNTRADABLE path.
costs.application: costs linear in fills (|dw| x band bps x multiplier / 10,000), charged exactly once per fill per side, applied to BOOKED PnL; no sidecar, no accrual-by-stamp. The neighbour's hedge legs are fills like any other and are charged identically.
costs.resolution: L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError; the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; terminal/exit fills of names whose band has become UNTRADABLE or missing are charged the C-rate ceiling (25 bps base / 50 stress) per resolve_exit_band_bps - a computed conservative resolution, never a default.
costs.stress: stress tier = x2 multiplier on booked PnL (20/30/50 bps); gate: stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.0.

arms.spec: The raw scheduling overlay: at each weekly scheduling decision, open one tranche holding every eligible entity whose predicted window ([next_hat - 7, next_hat + 7] calendar days) starts within the next 5 sessions; equal weight within the tranche (weight = 1/|tranche| of the 1.0 unit tranche); hold entry-to-exit as declared; no hedge leg, no sector conditioning, no direction - the exposure is long-only event-window holding. Abstain if the tranche would contain < 5 names (frozen floor).

Identical scheduling and name legs, each name leg paired 1:1 notional with a SHORT position in its mapped SPDR sector ETF entered and exited with the window - the sector-residual construction of plan 2.1. Mapping: the panel's own sector tag 's' (11 SPDR tickers, verified present: 11 mapped values plus UNMAPPED); UNMAPPED names hedge with SPY. Book-form justification frozen here ex-ante: the mechanism claims an IDIOSYNCRATIC uncertainty price paid to holders of event-window risk - sector beta is not the mechanism and is the program's most repeated measured killer (V2 momentum control 96.5% of anchor PnL; V10 ETF-share 0.8333/0.7407, SPY-excess 0/3 twice) - so the honest test of the idiosyncratic claim is the hedged construction. The neighbour SUPPORTS the anchor if it retains the premium; if the raw anchor appears profitable but the neighbour loses the edge, that is declared evidence of sector-timing and downweights the family regardless of the anchor. ETF-share of this arm is 0.500 BY CONSTRUCTION against the <= 0.50 gate: declared BOUNDARY with margin-to-fail exactly 0.0000 recorded per P-2; the family's binding gates are carried by the anchor (no ETF legs - ETF-share NOT_APPLICABLE ex-ante), and if Stage-A adjudicates the <= boundary strictly, the neighbour's verdict on that single gate is BOUNDARY_ADJUDICATED with the anchor unaffected.

The MANDATORY sham-event placebo class (plan structural mandate; P0 census section d proves runnability): identical machinery - same entities, same window length (+/- 7 calendar days), same scheduling grid, same eligibility, fills, costs and dead-leg semantics - with each anchor window replaced by a sham window placed deterministically at the first 15-calendar-day position, searched forward in 15-day steps from the anchor window start, that contains NO evidenced filer-event date of that entity (clearance against ALL of the entity's event dates, per the P0 placebo_calendar semantics). No optimization, no calendar preferences - first clear position wins. RUNNABILITY: P0 measured 8,034,881 clear 5-bar and 7,044,549 clear 20-bar window positions (96.1% / 84.6% of all positions; 2,158 of 2,161 priced entities have >= 1 clear 5-bar window); the declared exclusion-with-reason: entities with ZERO clear windows at the binding window length (3 measured at the 5-bar bracket) are excluded from THIS CONTROL ONLY with reason recorded, retained in anchor/neighbour (P0 limitation note tolerated as instructed). Refutation semantics: if the sham book reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign expectancy, or outrunning a negative anchor), the family's expectancy was generic time-in-market, not disclosure-event proximity, and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule. A sham control that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass - runnability is measured pre-selection, not assumed.

exposure_definition: Per entity i and scheduled window w (for the D2 rank-correlation screen against each of the ELEVEN veto entries on the same decision x entity cohort): EXPOSURE_i(w) = 1 if window w is an anchor-scheduled holding window for i (entry bar through exit bar as declared), else 0 - a time-conditional holding indicator. For decision-level D2 ranking, the indicator is pooled over windows: rank entities by the binary membership vector (scheduled-window holding vs not). Inputs are exactly the evidenced first_avail stamps of the V11-E1 stream, the published 364-day cadence constant of V11-E3, and the entity's own trading calendar from the price store; no return, volume, price level, filed value, sector weight, revision direction/severity or timing-lag observable enters the exposure. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho of this indicator exposure vs each veto-entry exposure; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required, measured pre-selection.

pre_selection_identifiability_check.anchor_vs_control_gate: pooled Spearman rho(anchor holding-indicator exposure vector, sham holding-indicator exposure vector) <= 0.10, measured BEFORE selection from the PIT panel + price availability only (both indicators are schedule arithmetic; no outcome file exists or is needed). Windows are placed to be disjoint from event dates by construction, so a measured rho > 0.10 means the sham was not placed as declared - a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.sham_match_rate_gate: >= 0.80 of anchor windows have a deterministically placeable length-matched clear sham window for the same entity, measured from the entity's evidenced event dates + trading calendar only (P0 measured clear-window density 84.6-96.1% supports this with margin; measured, not assumed).
pre_selection_identifiability_check.non_vacuity_gates: measured from PIT panel + price availability only: (i) >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold (lane pre-check: 37,527 predicted windows inside folds - 14,846 / 12,262 / 10,419 - across 2,131 priced tradable-cohort entities, 386 ALIVE + 1,726 DEAD); (ii) tranche floor >= 5 names; (iii) A9 re-verifies the entry-eligible subset before selection.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.control_can_refute: the sham calendar can refute the mechanism because it deletes exactly the disclosure-event proximity while holding the names, the window length, the schedule, the costs and the calendar time-in-market fixed; if the family's expectancy survives the deletion, the priced object is generic calendar exposure, not an uncertainty premium. Its verdict binds under the data semantics it was computed with (P-3) and recomputes under any semantics change.

incremental_alpha_test: per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract carried from V8/V9/V10: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen realized gross path - deterministic from the schedule), per fold and overall; gate: overall SPY-excess expectancy > 0 and >= 2 of 3 folds positive; secondary equal-weight 11-SPDR sector-ETF factor reported per fold, and for this family it is load-bearing reporting: the raw anchor's beta exposure is exactly what the neighbour's construction strips, so the fold-wise anchor-vs-neighbour delta is the preregistered sector-drowning diagnostic. ETF-share gate <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist: anchor has NO ETF legs (NOT_APPLICABLE declared ex-ante); neighbour has sector-hedged legs at 0.500 by construction - declared BOUNDARY, margin 0.0000, recorded per P-2. SPY-excess positivity declared for anchor and neighbour alike.
turnover_and_sample_floor: >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold (binding minimum; lane pre-check measured 37,527 schedulable windows in folds, so the expected scored count after eligibility is orders of magnitude above the floor; A9 verifies). One entry fill + one exit fill per window per side (plus the neighbour's hedge fills), charged exactly once per fill; window truncation at the dead tail adds no extra fills (exit-at-last-close IS the exit fill). If floors abstain the family under count, the verdict is INFEASIBLE (declared), never a silently reduced book.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution entity (largest cumulative tranche weight); survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) drop-one-fold: expectancy recomputed with each fold removed; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) drop-one-sector: rerun excluding the mapped SPDR sector with the largest cumulative tranche weight (the sector-drowning diagnostic in reverse; one rerun, declared, no others). All reruns inherit identical eligibility, bands, fills, costs, dead-name semantics and the recomputed sham control (P-3: controls recompute under semantics change).

margin_to_fail_expectations.window_expectancy_gt_0: coin-flip ex ante; the literature premium must clear an expected band-B/C-weighted cost of roughly 15-25 bps per round trip on a 10-11 bar hold; if it fails, expect a small negative (order 1e-4/window).
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.10: expected binding if the mechanism is real; margin expected thin (< 0.1) per P-2 knife-edge doctrine.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_of_3: MEDIUM-HIGH RISK: announcement-premium intensity varies with uncertainty regimes (the 2020 fold is a different market), so fold concentration is the declared most-likely structural failure.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: MEDIUM RISK for the raw anchor (long-only overlay carrying full market exposure in-window); the neighbour's residual construction is expected to show materially lower MDD - the declared diagnostic direction.
margin_to_fail_expectations.spy_excess_positivity: MEDIUM-HIGH RISK for the raw anchor by construction (long-only in-window exposure = deliberate market time-in-market); this is the honest crucible: the premium must exceed market drift over the windows, and the neighbour isolates the idiosyncratic remainder.
margin_to_fail_expectations.etf_share_le_0.50: anchor NOT_APPLICABLE ex-ante (no ETF legs); neighbour 0.500 by construction - declared BOUNDARY with margin 0.0000 per P-2 and its adjudication semantics frozen in the neighbour arm spec.
margin_to_fail_expectations.sham_control_ratio_lt_0.5: HIGH RISK and pre-committed: time-in-market and momentum-like calendar effects correlate with event windows in this cohort, so the sham retaining part of the anchor is the honest expectation; the family survives only if event proximity adds information beyond calendar placement. If the sham reproduces or outruns the anchor, accept falsification without argument (V5 sham-calendar lesson, imported).
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_2x: HIGH RISK if base-cost margin is thin (P-2 knife-edge doctrine).
margin_to_fail_expectations.scored_decision_floors: LOW RISK: lane pre-check measured 37,527 schedulable windows in folds across 2,131 priced tradable-cohort entities; entry-eligibility attrition would have to be extreme to fall under 30 overall / 5 per fold; abstention is fail-safe and INFEASIBLE is a declared verdict.
margin_to_fail_expectations.novelty_rho_le_0.20: expected PASS vs all ELEVEN entries: the exposure is a time-conditional holding indicator with no cross-sectional characteristic, return, variance, volume, filed-value or lag-level input anywhere; the nearest form in words is the V10 deseasonalized-timing characteristic book (both live near filing-timing machinery), with the concrete difference declared in novelty_declaration; measured, never argued, at D2.
margin_to_fail_expectations.reproduction_ALL_MATCH: required; process gate, no economic expectation.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_and_sham_negative: no disclosure-event premium at these costs and horizons on this cohort; REJECT with margin-to-fail per gate (P-2).
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_but_sham_reproduces: falsification-by-control fires: the priced object is generic calendar time-in-market, not event proximity; recorded, never rescued (mandatory placebo class instance; V5 lesson).
failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_sham_positive: the scheduled windows are adverse calendar exposures on this cohort - a stronger falsification than the anchor alone; REJECT.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_raw_but_neighbour_dead: sector-timing, not idiosyncratic uncertainty pricing; REJECT the family with the anchor-neighbour delta recorded as the measured confound - this outcome is exactly the sector-beta drowning the program has measured twice, and the 2.1 provision exists so it is diagnosed, not discovered post hoc.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_alpha_negative: market-timed window exposure, not mechanism; REJECT.
failure_interpretation.only_one_fold_positive: a single-regime uncertainty episode; not a persistent mechanism.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_all_gates: proceed to Stage-A with the preregistered parameters only; no re-tuning; margin-to-fail reported per gate; the neighbour's 0.500 ETF-share boundary adjudication recorded per its frozen semantics.

frozen_thresholds.cadence_anchor_364d: the predictor's single constant = the published pooled p50 of inter_arrival_days from the V11-E3 clock tuple (169/364/460) - a census statistic, not a fitted parameter; per-entity cadence estimation was REJECTED at design time (it would introduce a per-entity parameter and a grid-shaped surface; the pooled p50 is the only parameter-free cadence evidence in the packet).
frozen_thresholds.window_pm7_calendar_days: one symmetric +/-7-day pair: wide enough to straddle the arrival with margin for calendar drift, narrow enough that a 10-11 bar hold is cost-meaningful; rationale-first, single pair, no grid.
frozen_thresholds.scheduling_grid_5_sessions: weekly scheduling: windows are annual objects; a weekly grid cannot double-book an entity's next window and is the coarsest grid that schedules with <= 5 sessions of lead time; single constant.
frozen_thresholds.staleness_800d: predictor states older than 800 days abstain (P2 verbatim rule).
frozen_thresholds.tranche_floor_5_names: inherited accounting minimum (>= 1 non-CASH leg per scored decision with meaningful equal-weight dispersion), applied per tranche.
frozen_thresholds.sham_search_forward_15day_steps: deterministic first-clear-position rule: forward search in 15-day steps from the anchor window start; no calendar preference, no optimization, byte-reproducible.
frozen_thresholds.neighbour_hedge_1to1: 1:1 notional sector hedge on the neighbour only, justification frozen in the arm spec; the boundary ETF-share consequence is declared rather than engineered away (a < 1 hedge ratio would be a fitted parameter with no mechanism content).

no_parameter_grid_declaration: one cadence constant, one window pair, one scheduling step, one staleness bound, one floor per concept, one deterministic sham rule, one hedge ratio - all frozen above with stated rationale; no grid search over window lengths, cadence constants, scheduling frequencies, hedging ratios, universes, top-K or costs anywhere in any arm; the neighbour changes exactly one thing (hedge legs) and the control changes exactly one thing (window placement), both declared; drop-one reruns are declared diagnostics with no admission path back into the family parameters.

could_be_confused_with.momentum_incl_V2_ETF_relative: no return, price or volume input anywhere; a holding indicator over predicted calendar windows is not a return-ranked exposure - expected rho near zero; measured at D2.
could_be_confused_with.semivariance: no downside/variance object exists in the family; PASS.
could_be_confused_with.WC_stock_intensity: no working-capital or any filed-value object exists; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.Goodwill_bloat: no goodwill or growth object exists; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.F1_accrual_flow: no income-vs-cash item; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.depletion_runway_interaction: no capex/depletion/runway object; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.cash_level_shadow: no cash or balance-sheet LEVEL anywhere; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.sector_exposure_form: the SIGNAL contains no sector weighting; sector appears only in the neighbour's HEDGE LEGS (construction, not conditioning - plan 2.1 changes permissible construction only) and in benchmark reporting; the exposure is the holding indicator; measured at D2 on the conditioning exposures.
could_be_confused_with.V10_deseasonalized_timing_characteristic: the nearest form in words: both live near filing-timing machinery. Concrete design difference: the vetoed form is a CROSS-SECTIONAL book ranking a filer's deseasonalized filing-lag z-score LEVEL (own_z is the conditioning exposure); this family never reads a lag observable - first_avail DATES are used as calendar placement under the funded V11-E1 clock, the exposure is a binary window indicator, and no cross-sectional lag ranking exists anywhere; measured at D2 on the conditioning exposures, which is the binding adjudication.
could_be_confused_with.V10_revision_correction_direction_breadt: no corrected filed value, no direction/severity/breadth observable enters any arm; PASS by construction.

novelty_declaration.vs_prior_stocks_families: no prior stocks family - and no vetoed shadow - is a scheduling or announcement-premium book; the plan names event-form reaction and preregistered sector-residual books as never exercised by any cycle. This family preregisters the FIRST scheduling book and the FIRST mechanism-justified sector-residual neighbour in the program.
novelty_declaration.vs_axis_1_lane_filing_event_reaction: declared within-cycle separation: the axis-1 sanction (and the never-scored V10 A4-H2 class) is event-time DIRECTION/drift - conditioning a direction book on filing arrivals. This family is NON-DIRECTIONAL scheduling: it holds through windows regardless of any direction, drift or signal content, and its falsification object is the sham calendar rather than a placebo signal. If A1 measures insufficient within-cycle separation against a sibling axis-1 proposal at selection, the proposal is selectable-not-selected, not reworded.
